items:
📅 **January Milestones:**
• **15 Jan — 78th Indian Army Day:** Celebrated at Jaipur (4th time organized outside Delhi cantonment).
• **16 Jan — 77th NDA Raising Day:** National Defence Academy raising day.
• **25 Jan — 16th National Voters Day:** National theme *"My India, My Vote"*.

📅 **February Milestones:**
• **13 Feb — National Women’s Day:** Commemorating the birth anniversary of Sarojini Naidu.
• **20 Feb — Arunachal Pradesh 40th Statehood Day:** Statehood granted in 1987 (24th State of India).
• **24 Feb — ESIC Foundation Day (75th Jubilee):** ESI Act passed in 1948; scheme launched 24 Feb 1952.
• **28 Feb — National Science Day:** Commemorating discovery of the Raman Effect (Nobel Prize 1930); theme *"Women in Science"*.

📅 **March Milestones:**
• **1 Mar — 50th Civil Accounts Day:** Golden Jubilee edition.
• **7 Mar — 8th Janaushadhi Diwas:** Concluding PMBJP Janaushadhi Week (1–7 March).
• **8 Mar — International Women’s Day:** Global theme *"Rights. Justice. Action."*
• **23 Mar — Shaheed Diwas:** Martyrdom of Bhagat Singh, Rajguru, and Sukhdev (1931).
• **24 Mar — World Tuberculosis Day:** Global theme *"Yes! We can end TB!"*
• **28 Mar — 20th Earth Hour:** Observed 8:30–9:30 PM under WWF (initiated in 2007).

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — 78th Army Day (Jaipur); ESIC 75th Jubilee year; 50th Civil Accounts Day; 8th Janaushadhi Diwas; National Science Day theme "Women in Science".
